same_law.key_value: lesser of 5% or CPI change; one increase per 12 months
same_law.reason: Both cards cite Hoboken Code § 155-5 and state the same annual increase cap: the lesser of 5% or CPI. r-0074 also summarizes the vacancy decontrol figures, but those come from §§ 155-31 and 155-34, which stay as their own cards.
